body:
I believe this is due to the metric name being dropped before the annotation being outputted. eg:

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/promql/functions.go#L1373
Thanks for reporting. Your theory sounds plausible. Would you like to create a PR with the fix? Or @zenador maybe?
Assigning to myself to not lose track. Would still welcome a contribution from @jhesketh or @zenador (or anyone, of course – easy gain of Prometheus fame :grinning: ).

(sorry, I had missed this earlier). Sure, the allure of fame got me ;-). I can take a look at this :+1: 

Apparently I can't assign it to myself though if you'd like to pass it over let me know.

Hi @jhesketh , are you actively working on this? If not, I can take a look as I noticed something similar when querying for a non-monotonous classic histogram.
`PromQL warning: bucket label "le" is missing or has a malformed value of "" for metric name "" (1:26)`

@beorn7 How can I modify `mb.metric`, which currently has the value `{instance="192.168.1.23:2112", job="test-histogram"}`, to include the metric name under the label `__name__` (MetricName), so that functions like `Get(labels.MetricName)` work correctly? Specifically, do I need to explicitly add the `__name__` label to `mb.metric`, and is this the right approach to ensure compatibility with functions dependent on `MetricName`?

> PromQL warning: bucket label "le" is missing or has a malformed value of "" for metric name "" (1:26)

IMO `mb.metric` has only `instance` and `job` and does not have any of these
```go
       MetricName   = "__name__"
	AlertName    = "alertname"
	BucketLabel  = "le"
```
therefore "le" is showing and metric name is empty

@jhesketh has already concluded [above](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/issues/15411#issuecomment-2481695072) that the metric name is dropped before we generate the annotation. I don't have a detailed solution in my head. Finding out how to do this in a nice way is the main task while addressing this issue.

issue.title: Ensure metric name is present on histogram_quantile annotations

repository.name: prometheus
repository.description: The Prometheus monitoring system and time series database.

issue.body:
Previously the series __name__ label was dropped before the annotation was emitted causing the annotation message to have a blank value.

This fix also allows delayed name removal for classic histograms.

Fixes: #15411

body:
Hello everybody,

Very sorry for such a slow effort on this one. It fell down the priority list and PTO disruptions etc.

I've opened a PR that should close this issue out, including the fix for bad `le` labels. It also expands the tests for the annotations.

The annotation for bad `le` labels should probably be broken into two (one for missing le, and one for malformed), but I think that's outside the scope of this change and likely isn't common enough to need a new annotation.

https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/15828

Sorry again for the delay!
